definition_zh: 保存；保护；节约（资源）；把果子熬成蜜饯
definition_en: to keep something in good condition and prevent it from being damaged, wasted or used up
core_image: 一间恒温恒湿的库房把老纸页锁在里面，门外是不断变化的天气，门内一切不变
scene: 这组词中，Volunteers conserve the fragile manuscripts in a climate-controlled vault.
sceneCN: 这里 conserve 指「妥善保存，使易损物件不继续损坏」（第 1 个义项：把物件维持在稳定状态以免受损）；句意为志愿者把易损手稿放进恒温恒湿的库房保存。图中可辨识物件：恒温柜、平放的纸页、湿度表、白手套。

pos.zh: 保存；保护；节约（资源、能量）
蜜饯；果脯（英式，指加糖熬煮的果酱）

senses.title: Keep an object from further damage
senses.titleCN: 把物件维持在稳定环境以免继续损坏
senses.definition: to keep a fragile object in a stable condition so that it does not decay or break down
senses.definitionCN: 把易损物件维持在稳定条件下，使其不再腐坏或破损
senses.example: Volunteers conserve the fragile manuscripts in a climate-controlled vault.
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者把易损手稿保存在恒温恒湿的库房里。
senses.why: conserve is built from com- 'thoroughly' plus servare 'to keep safe', so the core reading is to keep something safe all round.
senses.whyCN: conserve 由 com-「彻底」加 servare「守住」构成，核心意思就是「把某物整个守住」。

senses.title: Protect a natural resource
senses.titleCN: 保护自然资源，使其能长期存在
senses.definition: to use a natural resource carefully so that it survives for future use
senses.definitionCN: 谨慎使用自然资源，使其能留存到未来
senses.example: Ranchers conserve grassland by rotating their herds.
senses.exampleCN: 牧场主用轮牧的方式保护草地。
senses.why: the environmental sense grew out of the older one: a forest is kept safe by limiting how much is taken from it.
senses.whyCN: 环保义由旧义延伸而来：限制取用量，就是让森林保持安全。

senses.title: Avoid wasting time or effort
senses.titleCN: 节省体力、时间与燃料，不作无谓消耗
senses.definition: to avoid using up energy, time or strength unnecessarily
senses.definitionCN: 避免无谓地消耗体力、时间或力量
senses.example: Runners conserve energy on the climb so they can sprint at the end.
senses.exampleCN: 跑者在爬坡时保存体力，好在最后冲刺。
senses.why: keeping a supply safe and not drawing on it are the same idea seen from two sides, so conserve slid into the sense of saving.
senses.whyCN: 把储备守住与不动用它，是同一件事的两面，因此 conserve 自然引申出「节省」。

senses.title: Cook fruit into a conserve
senses.definition: to cook fruit with sugar so that it keeps for a long time
senses.definitionCN: 把水果与糖一起熬煮，使其能长期存放
senses.example: They conserve plums with honey and a little lemon.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把李子加蜂蜜和少许柠檬熬成蜜饯。
senses.why: from the sixteenth century the word was applied to food kept safe by sugar, since sugar does for fruit what a vault does for paper.
senses.whyCN: 从 16 世纪起，这个词用于靠糖保住的食物：糖对果子做的事，正如库房对纸页做的事。

senses.title: A thick fruit jam
senses.definition: a thick sweet preparation of fruit cooked with sugar
senses.definitionCN: 水果加糖熬成的浓稠甜品
senses.example: A spoonful of apricot conserve went onto the warm bread.
senses.exampleCN: 一勺杏子蜜饯抹在热面包上。
senses.why: the noun is simply the product of the verb, so English uses the same form for the act and for the jar.
senses.whyCN: 名词只是动词的产物，因此英语用同一个词形既指动作也指罐中之物。

senses.title: Hold a quantity constant in physics
senses.titleCN: 物理中保持某个量守恒
senses.definition: to remain constant through a physical process, as mass or charge does
senses.definitionCN: 在物理过程中保持不变，如质量或电荷
senses.example: In an isolated system, charge is conserved through every reaction.
senses.exampleCN: 在孤立系统中，电荷在每一次反应中都守恒。
senses.why: the older sense of keeping something intact was narrowed by physics into the rule that a total does not change.
senses.whyCN: 「保持完整」的旧义被物理学收窄为一条规则：总量不发生变化。

senses.title: Keep a right or condition in force
senses.titleCN: 使某项权利或状态继续有效
senses.definition: to keep a legal right or an arrangement valid rather than letting it lapse
senses.definitionCN: 使法律权利或某种安排继续有效，而非任其失效
senses.example: The clause conserves the tenant's right to renew the lease.
senses.exampleCN: 该条款保留了租客续租的权利。
senses.why: law borrowed the word because a right that is kept safe is a right that is not lost by silence or delay.
senses.whyCN: 法律借用这个词，因为权利被守住就意味着不因沉默或拖延而丧失。

senses.title: Keep the essential character
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：在变形中保住核心特征
senses.definition: to keep the essential character of something even when its outward form changes
senses.definitionCN: 即使外在形式改变，也保住某物的核心特征
senses.example: The arranger conserved the melody while rewriting every harmony.
senses.exampleCN: 编曲者改写了全部和声，却保住了旋律。
senses.why: the abstract sense generalizes the core: what is conserved is no longer a thing but the pattern that makes it what it is.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义把核心一般化：被守住的不再是一件东西，而是使它成为它的那个格局。

intro.en: Conserve comes through Old French from Latin conservare 'to keep safe, maintain', built on com- 'together, thoroughly' and servare 'to keep, watch over'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: conserve 经古法语来自拉丁 conservare「保住、维持」，由 com-「共同、彻底」与 servare「看守、保存」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Servare meant 'to keep, watch over, guard'. Its deeper origin is not established; the link sometimes suggested to servire 'to serve' is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated derivation.
items.cn: servare 意为「看守、保存、守护」。其更深来源未得到证明；有人把它与 servire「服侍」联系起来，那只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: Com- 'together, thoroughly' plus servare produced conservare 'to keep safe, to maintain, to preserve'.
items.cn: com-「共同、彻底」加 servare 构成 conservare「保住、维持、保存」。

items.en: Old French conserver carried the verb into English in the fourteenth century, first in the sense of keeping health or a condition intact.
items.cn: 古法语 conserver 在 14 世纪把这个动词带入英语，最初指保持健康或某种状态不坏。

items.en: By the sixteenth century conserve was used for fruit cooked with sugar, and the noun for the product followed soon after.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，conserve 已用于指加糖熬煮的水果，指成品的名词义随后出现。

items.en: From the nineteenth century the word was applied to forests, soil and wildlife, and this resource sense now dominates everyday use.
items.cn: 从 19 世纪起，这个词被用于森林、土壤与野生动物，这一资源义如今在日常使用中占主导。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper origin): no exact first citation is recorded for the resource sense, and the pre-Latin origin of servare is unsettled, so any Indo-European form offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：资源义没有确切的最早书证；servare 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论，凡为其给出的印欧形式均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds verbs built on the Latin -serve stock that are constantly confused; group two holds near neighbours with a different shade of keeping.
note.cn: 第一组是同出拉丁 -serve 词干、极易混淆的动词；第二组是语义相近但「保住」的侧重点不同的词。

entries.definition: Built on prae- 'before' plus servare, so it stresses protecting something before harm reaches it; it also names jam and a nature reserve.
entries.definitionCN: 由 prae-「在前」加 servare 构成，强调在损害到来之前先护住；也指果酱与自然保护区。

entries.definition: Re- 'back' plus servare: to hold something back for later use, as in reserve a seat or oil reserves.
entries.definitionCN: re-「向后」加 servare：把某物留到以后用，如预订座位、石油储量。

entries.definition: From de- 'fully' plus servire 'to serve', not servare: to have earned something by service, so it is not a relative of conserve at the root.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 de-「完全」加 servire「服侍」，而非 servare：因服务而应得，因此词根上与 conserve 并非同族。

entries.definition: Ob- 'toward' plus servare: to keep one's eyes on something, hence to watch, notice or obey a rule.
entries.definitionCN: ob-「朝向」加 servare：把目光守在事物上，因此指观察、注意或遵守规则。

entries.definition: A general verb for shielding something from danger; it says nothing about careful use, which conserve adds.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指使某物免受危险，不含「节制使用」的意思，而 conserve 带有这一层。

entries.definition: To keep something in its current working condition, as a road or a machine; conserve is closer to keeping it from loss.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持现有的运转状态，如道路或机器；conserve 更偏向使之不致损失。

entries.definition: The common verb for avoiding waste, as in save water; conserve is its formal and technical counterpart.
entries.definitionCN: 指避免浪费的日常动词，如节约用水；conserve 是它正式、技术化的对应词。

entries.definition: To continue to hold something already possessed, such as heat or a right; it does not imply active care.
entries.definitionCN: 指继续保有已拥有之物，如热量或权利；不含主动照料之意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: com- 'thoroughly' + servare 'keep safe': to keep something safe all round.
normal.cn: com-「彻底」+ servare「守住」：把某物整个护住。

normal.en: The family runs conserve, conservation, conservative, conservationist, conservator, conservancy.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 conserve、conservation、conservative、conservationist、conservator、conservancy。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the resource sense: conserve energy, conserve water, conserve wildlife.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出资源义：节约能源、节约用水、保护野生动物。

normal.en: The same root appears in preserve, reserve and observe, all through Latin servare.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 preserve、reserve 与 observe 中，都经拉丁 servare。

normal.en: Physics uses the passive form: charge is conserved, energy is conserved.
normal.cn: 物理用被动式：电荷守恒、能量守恒。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed jar that holds summer inside it while winter runs outside.
abstract.cn: 想象一只密封罐，里面装着夏天，外面正跑着冬天。

abstract.en: Picture a bank account nobody draws from, so the balance stays what it was.
abstract.cn: 想象一个没人取钱的账户，余额始终停在原处。

abstract.en: Picture a song rearranged into a new key but still recognizably itself.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌被改写调性，却仍听得出是原来的歌。

examples.en: The trust conserves the wetland by buying the land around it.
examples.cn: 该信托基金买下周边土地，以保护这片湿地。

examples.en: Turning off unused lights conserves both energy and money.
examples.cn: 关掉不用的灯既省能源也省钱。

examples.en: In every chemical reaction, the total mass is conserved.
examples.cn: 在每一个化学反应中，总质量守恒。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「con（共同）+ serve（服务/看守）」——大家一起守住资源 → 保存、保护、节约

root: 拉丁 conservare「保住、维持」= com-（共同、彻底）+ servare「看守、保存」；servare 更深来源不确定，与 servire「服侍」的联系仅为假说。英语 conserve。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one gesture: something valuable is closed off from decay, and that gesture is then applied to forests, fuel, fruit, physical totals, legal rights and finally to a pattern that survives a rewrite.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：把有价值之物与腐坏隔开，这个动作再依次用于森林、燃料、果子、物理总量、法律权利，最后用于一个经改写仍存活的格局。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stable room holding something precious while the weather outside keeps changing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间稳定的屋子守住贵重之物，屋外天气不断变化。

branches.en: KEEP-SAFE OBJECT: whether paper or a lease, the point is that nothing is lost.
branches.cn: 守住对象：无论纸页还是租约，要点都是不让它失去。

branches.en: WISE USE: a supply is kept safe by drawing on it slowly.
branches.cn: 善用：慢慢取用，储备才得以安全。

branches.en: SEALED FRUIT: sugar does for fruit what a vault does for paper.
branches.cn: 封住的果子：糖对果子做的事，正如库房对纸页做的事。

branches.en: CONSTANT TOTAL: physics narrows keeping intact to a number that never changes.
branches.cn: 总量不变：物理学把「保持完整」收窄为一个永不改变的数。

branches.en: SURVIVING PATTERN: what is kept is no longer a thing but the shape that makes it itself.
branches.cn: 存活的格局：被守住的不再是实体，而是使它成为它的形态。

intro.en: Conserve is a Latin verb made of a prefix and a root that also build several other English words, so the whole family can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: conserve 是一个由前缀与词根构成的拉丁动词，这两部分还构成若干英语词，因此整个词族可以按语素逐个读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin servare gives conserve, preserve, reserve, observe and servitude; com- adds the sense of doing something thoroughly or together.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 servare 衍生 conserve、preserve、reserve、observe 与 servitude；com- 增添「彻底、共同」的意思。

items.example: The prefix binds the action into a single whole.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把动作收束为一个整体。

items.example: The root carries the idea of keeping watch.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「看守」的意思。

items.meaning: the act or result of keeping safe
tending to keep things as they are
items.meaningCN: 倾向维持原状的；保守的
items.example: She took a conservative estimate of the cost.
items.exampleCN: 她对成本做了保守的估计。

items.meaning: a person who works to protect nature
items.example: The conservationist mapped the last old-growth stands.
items.exampleCN: 这位自然保护者标出了最后几片原始林。

items.meaning: a person who repairs and maintains objects
items.example: The conservator cleaned the painting layer by layer.
items.exampleCN: 修复师一层层地清理这幅画。

items.meaning: an organization or area that manages protection
items.meaningCN: 保护管理机构或保护区
items.example: The river conservancy patrols the banks.
items.exampleCN: 河流保护机构巡护两岸。

items.example: Only a conservable portion of the archive survived.
items.exampleCN: 档案中只有可保存的一部分留了下来。

definition_zh: 考虑；认为；顾及；体谅
definition_en: to think about something carefully, or to regard it in a certain way
core_image: 桌上摊着两份合同，手指在纸边来回摩挲
scene: 她盯着两份合同，笔尖在纸上轻轻点了两下。She needed a week to consider the offer.
sceneCN: 这里 consider 指「考虑」（第 1 个义项：在决定前仔细思考）；句意是她需要一周时间来考虑这个提议。

senses.title: Think about
senses.definition: to think about something before deciding
senses.definitionCN: 在做出决定之前仔细思考某事
senses.example: We are considering moving to another city.
senses.exampleCN: 我们正在考虑搬到另一座城市。
senses.why: A choice is weighed in the mind before it is made by the hand.
senses.whyCN: 选择先在心里过秤，然后才由手做出。

senses.title: Regard as
senses.definition: to have an opinion about someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 对某人或某事物持有某种看法
senses.example: Many consider him the best player alive.
senses.exampleCN: 很多人认为他是当今最好的球员。
senses.why: The mind takes a position and then stands there.
senses.whyCN: 头脑选定一个位置，然后就站在那里。

senses.title: Take into account
senses.definition: to take someone's feelings or needs into account
senses.definitionCN: 把某人的感受或需要纳入考虑
senses.example: She never considers how others feel.
senses.exampleCN: 她从不考虑别人的感受。
senses.why: Thinking well means letting another person into the room.
senses.whyCN: 好好思考，意味着让别人也走进这间屋子。

intro.en: Consider comes from Latin considerare, to examine closely, probably from com-, together, and sidus, star, as if reading the sky.
intro.cn: consider 来自拉丁语 considerare，意为仔细审视，可能由 com-（一起）与 sidus（星）构成，仿佛在观测星空。

items.en: Sidus meant a star or a group of stars.
items.cn: sidus 意为星辰或一组星。

items.en: Considerare may have meant to observe the stars carefully.
items.cn: considerare 可能原指仔细观测星象。

items.en: From watching the sky it came to mean examining anything.
items.cn: 从仰望天空，它转而表示审视任何事物。

items.en: Old French considerer kept the sense of thinking over.
items.cn: 古法语 considerer 保留了反复思量的含义。

items.en: English consider first meant to look at something with care.
items.cn: 英语 consider 最初指带着用心去看。

items.en: It now covers thinking, judging and taking others into account.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖思考、判断与顾及他人。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on the consider family, and the meaning group names other ways of thinking something over.
note.cn: 形近组是 consider 家族，近义组列出其他表示反复思量的词。

entries.definition: large enough to be noticed
careful about other people's feelings
careful thought about something
to think about something for a long time
to think carefully before deciding
to look at or think of in a certain way

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from reading the stars, then move to two papers on a desk and to a friend you finally remember to ask.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从观测星辰开始，再到桌上摊着的两份文件，最后到终于想起来去问的那位朋友。

normal.en: Con- is together and sider- is star, so consider is to line up the stars before acting.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sider- 是星，consider 就是行动前先把星象排一排。

normal.en: Two papers on a desk: the mind walks between them.
normal.cn: 桌上两份文件，心思在两者之间来回走。

normal.en: All things considered means the scales were fully loaded first.
normal.cn: all things considered 意思是天平上先放满了东西。

normal.en: To consider others is to give them a chair at your table.
normal.cn: consider 别人，就是给他们在你桌边留一把椅子。

normal.en: A good decision is a slow decision that looks like a fast one.
normal.cn: 好决定是慢的，只是看起来很快。

abstract.en: Picture a hand turning a coin over twice.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把一枚硬币翻来覆去。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp above two papers late at night.
abstract.cn: 想象深夜一盏灯照着两份文件。

abstract.en: Picture a pause before a signature.
abstract.cn: 想象签名之前的一段停顿。

examples.en: We are considering moving to another city.
examples.cn: 我们正在考虑搬到另一座城市。

examples.en: Many consider her the best teacher here.
examples.cn: 很多人认为她是这里最好的老师。

examples.en: He never considers how his words sound.
examples.cn: 他从不考虑自己的话听起来是什么滋味。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consider 记成 con（一起）加 sider（星）：古人行动前先一起看星象，引申为把各种可能都想一遍，即考虑。

root: 源自拉丁语 considerare（com 一起 + sidus 星辰），本义可能是观测星象，后指仔细审视、思考与顾及。

sensesIntro.en: From scanning the sky, to weighing options, to forming an opinion, and at last to remembering other people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从扫视天空，到权衡选项，再到形成看法，最后到把别人放在心上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: eyes lifted to the stars, then lowered to a choice.
core.cn: 核心意象：眼睛先抬向星辰，再落到一个选择上。

branches.en: The first sense is thinking before deciding.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是决定之前的思考。

branches.en: The second sense is the opinion that such thought produces.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是这种思考所得出的看法。

branches.en: The third sense turns thought toward other people.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把思虑转向他人。

branches.en: Weighing facts and judging them are two steps of one act.
branches.cn: 权衡事实与给出判断，是同一个动作的两步。

branches.en: A person who counts others as real is considered kind.
branches.cn: 把别人当回事的人，会被认为善良。

intro.en: Consider is built on Latin considerare, possibly from com-, together, and sidus, star.
intro.cn: consider 由拉丁语 considerare 构成，可能源自 com-（一起）与 sidus（星辰）。

latinIntro.en: The star base sider- also appears in sidereal, and the related desire came from desiderare, to long for the stars.
latinIntro.cn: 星辰词基 sider- 也出现在 sidereal 中，而相关的 desire 来自 desiderare，意为向往星辰。

items.example: Consider the price before you buy.

items.exampleCN: 这个计划正在考虑之中。
她想旅行的愿望越来越强。

items.example: A sidereal day is slightly shorter.

definition_zh: 相当大的；相当多的；值得考虑的
definition_en: large enough in amount or degree to be noticed and counted
core_image: 账单上的数字比预想多出一大截
scene: 他打开账单，发现数字比预想多出一大截。The repair cost a considerable sum.
sceneCN: 这里 considerable 指「相当大的」（第 1 个义项：数量或程度大到值得注意）；句意是这次维修花了一笔相当可观的钱。

pos.zh: 相当大的；相当多的；值得考虑的

senses.title: Large in amount
senses.definition: large enough in amount or degree to be noticed
senses.definitionCN: 数量或程度大到值得注意
senses.example: The repair cost a considerable sum.
senses.exampleCN: 这次维修花了一笔相当可观的钱。
senses.why: A size that makes you stop and look is a size that counts.
senses.whyCN: 大到让你停下来看的规模，就是有分量的规模。

senses.title: Worth attention
senses.definition: important enough to deserve attention, an older and rarer sense
senses.definitionCN: 重要到值得关注，是较古老且少用的义项
senses.example: It was a considerable event in local history.
senses.exampleCN: 这是地方史上值得重视的事件。
senses.why: What deserves thought is what pulls the eye toward it.
senses.whyCN: 值得思考的东西，会把目光拉向自己。

intro.en: Considerable is consider plus -able, from Latin considerare, to examine, and it first meant able to be considered.
intro.cn: considerable 是 consider 加 -able，源自动词 considerare（审视），最初意为值得被考虑的。

items.en: Considerare meant to examine something closely.
items.cn: considerare 意为仔细审视某物。

items.en: The suffix -abilis marked what could be done.
items.cn: 词尾 -abilis 表示可以被怎样对待。

items.en: French considerable meant worthy of attention.
items.cn: 法语 considerable 意为值得注意的。

items.en: English considerable first meant able to be considered.
items.cn: 英语 considerable 最初指可以被考虑的。

items.en: It shifted to mean great in size or amount.
items.cn: 它的含义转向规模或数量很大。

items.en: Today the size sense is the everyday one.
items.cn: 今天日常使用的主要是表示规模大的义项。

note.en: The look-alike group is the consider family, and the meaning group names other words for a large amount.
note.cn: 形近组是 consider 家族，近义组列出其他表示数量大的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a bill larger than expected, then move to progress you can measure and to an event people still discuss.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从比预想更大的账单开始，再到可以量出的进步，最后到人们仍在谈论的事件。

normal.en: Considerable means big enough that you must consider it.
normal.cn: considerable 就是大到你必须把它考虑进去。

normal.en: A considerable sum is one that changes the plan.
normal.cn: 一笔可观的款子，是能改变计划的那种钱。

normal.en: Considerable progress can be measured, not merely felt.
normal.cn: 相当大的进步是量得出来的，不只是感觉。

normal.en: If nobody would notice its absence, it is not considerable.
normal.cn: 若它不在了也没人察觉，那它就称不上相当大。

normal.en: Think of a shadow long enough to reach the wall.
normal.cn: 想想一道长到能碰到墙的影子。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of coins higher than the cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一摞比杯子还高的硬币。

abstract.en: Picture a gap in the road you cannot step over.
abstract.cn: 想象路上一道你迈不过去的缺口。

abstract.en: Picture a number that makes a hand pause.
abstract.cn: 想象一个让手停下来的数字。

examples.cn: 这次维修花了一笔相当可观的钱。

examples.cn: 她在这份报告上花了相当多的时间。

examples.en: The project made considerable progress this year.

root: 由拉丁语 considerare（审视）加 -able 构成，原意是值得被考虑的，后转为数量或程度相当大的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a number on a bill that makes the hand pause.

branches.cn: 主要义项是大到能被计入的规模。

branches.en: The older sense is importance that earns attention.

branches.en: A large amount of anything becomes important by its weight.
branches.cn: 任何东西的数量一大，就凭分量变得重要。

branches.en: Comparatives like more considerable are rare but regular.
branches.cn: 像 more considerable 这样的比较级少见，但合乎规则。

branches.en: In old texts the word can mean worthy of respect.
branches.cn: 在旧文本里，这个词也可以指值得尊重的。

definition_zh: 体贴的；为他人着想的；考虑周到的
definition_en: careful not to upset others, and thoughtful about their needs

pos.zh: 体贴的；为他人着想的；考虑周到的

senses.title: Thinking of others
senses.definition: careful about other people's feelings and needs
senses.definitionCN: 在意他人的感受与需要
senses.example: It was considerate of her to call first.
senses.exampleCN: 她先打了个电话，真体贴。
senses.why: A small act says that another person is real to you.
senses.whyCN: 一个小动作，说明另一个人在你心里是真实的。

senses.title: Thoughtful in action
senses.definition: showing care in what one does or says
senses.definitionCN: 在言行中表现出用心
senses.example: He left a considerate note on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 他在桌上留了一张体贴的便条。
senses.why: Care becomes visible only when it moves a hand or a word.
senses.whyCN: 用心只有推动了一只手或一句话，才变得可见。

senses.title: Careful by design
senses.definition: showing careful thought rather than haste, an older sense
senses.definitionCN: 表现出仔细思量而非匆忙，是较古老的义项
senses.example: His considerate reply avoided every sharp word.
senses.exampleCN: 他那番经过思量的回答避开了所有锋利的词。
senses.why: The word once meant thought-through before it meant kind.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在表示善良之前，先表示想清楚了。

intro.en: Considerate comes from Latin consideratus, examined and thought over, from considerare, to look at closely.
intro.cn: considerate 来自拉丁语 consideratus，意为经过审视与思量的，源头是 considerare（仔细看）。

items.en: Considerare meant to examine something with care.
items.cn: considerare 意为用心审视某物。

items.en: Consideratus described a matter already weighed in the mind.
items.cn: consideratus 描述的是心里已经掂量过的事。

items.en: English considerate first meant deliberate and thoughtful.
items.cn: 英语 considerate 最初指深思熟虑的。

items.en: It shifted toward thought for other people's comfort.
items.cn: 它的含义转向对他人舒适感受的照顾。

items.en: Today it names the habit of not troubling others.
items.cn: 如今它指不给人添麻烦的习惯。

note.en: The look-alike group is the consider family, and the meaning group names other words for caring about others.
note.cn: 形近组是 consider 家族，近义组列出其他表示关心他人的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a key turned slowly, then move to a note left on a table and to a reply with no sharp edges.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从慢慢转动的钥匙开始，再到留在桌上的便条，最后到一句没有棱角的回答。

normal.en: Considerate is consider plus -ate: someone who thinks about you before acting.
normal.cn: considerate 是 consider 加 -ate：行动之前先想到你的人。

normal.en: A considerate person closes doors as if someone is asleep.
normal.cn: 体贴的人关门时，像屋里有人正在睡觉。

normal.en: Leaving the last seat for someone else is the whole idea.
normal.cn: 把最后一个座位留给别人，就是这个词的全部意思。

normal.en: It is not politeness of form, but attention of mind.
normal.cn: 它不是形式上的礼貌，而是心思上的在意。

normal.en: If your act costs you little and saves another much, it is considerate.
normal.cn: 若你的举动花费很小、却让别人省下很多，那就是体贴。

abstract.en: Picture a door easing shut without a sound.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门无声地慢慢合上。

abstract.en: Picture a cup of water set beside a sleeping friend.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯水放在熟睡的朋友身边。

abstract.en: Picture a chair pulled out for someone older.
abstract.cn: 想象为年长者拉开的一把椅子。

examples.en: It was considerate of her to call first.
examples.cn: 她先打了电话，真体贴。

examples.en: He is always considerate towards new students.
examples.cn: 他对新来的学生总是很体贴。

examples.en: A considerate reply can end an argument.
examples.cn: 一句体贴的回答可以结束一场争吵。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 considerate 记成 consider（考虑）加 ate：做事之前先考虑到别人，就是体贴。

root: 源自拉丁语 consideratus（经过审视的），由 considerare 加 -ate 构成，本义是想得周到，后专指体贴他人。

sensesIntro.en: From careful thought, to thought turned toward other people, and finally to the small acts that prove it.
sensesIntro.cn: 从仔细思量，到把思量转向别人，最后到证明这一点的小动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a key turned slowly so no one wakes.
core.cn: 核心意象：钥匙慢慢转动，好不吵醒任何人。

branches.en: The first sense is care for another person's feelings.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是在意另一个人的感受。

branches.en: The second sense makes that care visible in words or acts.
branches.cn: 第二个义项让这份在意在言行中显露出来。

branches.en: The older sense stresses thought before action.
branches.cn: 较古老的义项强调行动之前的思量。

branches.en: Feeling for others and acting on it belong together.
branches.cn: 替别人感受与照着去做，本来就是一回事。

branches.en: A careful act is both thought through and kind.
branches.cn: 周到的举动，既经过思量，也带着善意。

intro.en: Considerate is consider plus -ate, from Latin consideratus, thought over.
intro.cn: considerate 是 consider 加 -ate，源自拉丁语 consideratus（经过思量的）。

latinIntro.cn: 星辰词基 sider- 也出现在 sidereal 中，同一个词根也塑造了 desire。

这么大声放音乐很不体谅人。
对安静的渴望越来越强。

definition_zh: 考虑；需要考虑的因素；体谅
definition_en: the act of thinking carefully about something, or a fact that must be weighed
core_image: 桌上摊着几张纸，一个人托着下巴逐条权衡
scene: 面试前夜，她把每个条件在纸上排了一遍。After long consideration, she accepted the offer.
sceneCN: 这里 consideration 指「仔细考虑」（第 1 个义项：对某事反复权衡）；句意是经过长时间的考虑，她接受了这份工作。

pos.zh: 考虑；需要考虑的因素；体谅

senses.title: Careful thought
senses.definition: the act of thinking about something carefully before acting
senses.definitionCN: 行动之前对某事反复思考
senses.example: After much consideration, they chose the cheaper plan.
senses.exampleCN: 经过再三考虑，他们选择了更便宜的那个方案。
senses.why: A decision made in a hurry often misses what a slow look would catch.
senses.whyCN: 匆忙作出的决定，常常漏掉慢看时能看见的东西。

senses.title: A fact to weigh
senses.definition: something that must be taken into account when deciding
senses.definitionCN: 做决定时必须纳入权衡的事情
senses.example: Cost is only one consideration here.
senses.exampleCN: 在这里，成本只是需要考虑的一个因素。
senses.why: A good choice needs more than one item on the scale.
senses.whyCN: 好的选择需要天平上不只放一样东西。

senses.title: Thought for others
senses.definition: kind attention to the feelings of other people
senses.definitionCN: 对他人感受的体贴照顾
senses.example: He showed no consideration for the tired staff.
senses.exampleCN: 他对疲惫的员工毫不体谅。
senses.why: The same mind that weighs facts can also weigh feelings.
senses.whyCN: 权衡事实的那颗心，也能权衡别人的感受。

intro.en: Consideration comes from Latin considerare, to look at closely, a word once linked to sidus, a star, as if reading the sky.
intro.cn: consideration 来自拉丁语 considerare，意为仔细察看，旧说与 sidus（星星）有关，仿佛观星以定吉凶。

items.en: Sidus meant star, and considerare may once have meant to observe the stars.
items.cn: sidus 意为星星，considerare 最初可能指观察星象。

items.en: Considerare widened to mean examining anything with care.
items.cn: considerare 的词义扩大为仔细察看任何事物。

items.en: The noun consideratio named the act of careful looking.
items.cn: 名词 consideratio 指仔细察看这一行为。

items.en: French consideration carried the sense of respectful regard.
items.cn: 法语 consideration 带有尊重与顾念的含义。

items.en: English consideration first meant careful thought before a choice.
items.cn: 英语 consideration 最初指做选择前的仔细思考。

items.en: It now also names a single fact that must be weighed.
items.cn: 如今它也指必须纳入权衡的某一因素。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words from the same consider- family, and the meaning group names other kinds of careful thought.
note.cn: 形近组收的是同一个 consider- 词族的词，近义组列出其他表示仔细思量的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a slow look at the facts, then move to the single fact that tips a choice and to care for other people.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从慢慢端详事实开始，再到压动选择的那一个因素，最后落到对他人的体谅。

normal.en: Con- is together and sider is star, so consideration is reading the sky before you move.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sider 是星星，consideration 就是先看星象再行动。

normal.en: A table with three papers on it: that is consideration at work.
normal.cn: 桌上摊着三张纸，这就是考虑正在进行的样子。

normal.en: One factor is not a decision, so consideration puts several on the scale.
normal.cn: 一个因素不成决定，所以考虑要把好几样放上天平。

normal.en: Consideration for others is the same word turned toward feelings.

normal.en: Look twice, then act once.
normal.cn: 看两遍，再动手一次。

abstract.en: Picture a hand holding a scale that is still moving.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手扶着一架仍在晃动的天平。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp over a page full of small notes.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯照着一页密密麻麻的小字。

abstract.en: Picture a chair pulled out for someone who looks tired.
abstract.cn: 想象有人为一位显出疲态的人拉开椅子。

examples.en: After much consideration, she turned down the offer.
examples.cn: 经过反复考虑，她拒绝了那份邀约。

examples.en: Safety must be the first consideration in this design.
examples.cn: 在这个设计里，安全必须是首要的考虑。

examples.en: He treats his staff with real consideration.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consideration 记成 con（一起）加 sider（星星）加 ation：像古人一起看星推演吉凶那样反复权衡，就是考虑。

root: 源自拉丁语 considerare（仔细察看），旧说与 sidus（星星）有关，仿佛观星以定吉凶，后指考虑、需要权衡的因素与体谅。

sensesIntro.en: From slow looking, to the facts that demand a look, and finally to looking after other people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从慢慢察看，到必须察看的事实，最后到照看别人的感受。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scale on a table with papers on both sides.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上放着一架天平，两边都压着纸。

branches.en: Careful thought slows the hand before it moves.

branches.en: A single consideration can change the whole balance.
branches.cn: 一个因素就能改变整个平衡。

branches.en: The same habit of mind turns into kindness toward people.
branches.cn: 同一种思维习惯转向人，就成了体贴。

branches.en: Both senses put something on a scale and wait for it to settle.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是把东西放上天平，等它稳定下来。

branches.en: A person can be the factor that a careful mind weighs.
branches.cn: 人本身也可以成为那颗细心的心所权衡的因素。

intro.en: Consideration is built on Latin con-, together, plus considerare, to examine.

latinIntro.en: The Latin star base sider- also appears in sidereal, while the consider- family runs through consider and considerable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的星词基 sider- 也出现在 sidereal 中，而 consider- 词族贯穿 consider 与 considerable。

definition_zh: 一致性；连贯性；稳定度；（混合物的）均匀度、浓稠度
definition_en: the quality of staying the same over time, or of having parts that agree with one another
core_image: 同一桶颜料反复倒出，每次颜色与质地都分毫不差
scene: 这组词中，Before shipping the sauce, the chef checks the consistency of every batch with a spoon.
sceneCN: 这里 consistency 是「（酱料的）均匀度、浓稠度」（第 5 个义项：质地均匀度）；句意：发货前，厨师用勺子检查每一批酱料的浓稠度是否均匀。图中可辨识物件：酱料桶、勺子、批次标签、记录表。

pos.zh: 一致性；连贯性；稳定度；均匀度

senses.title: Agreement: the state of staying the same
senses.titleCN: 一致性：前后相同的状态
senses.definition: the quality of remaining the same, or of agreeing with something else
senses.definitionCN: 保持不变或与其他事物相符合的性质
senses.example: There is no consistency between his words and his actions.
senses.exampleCN: 他的言行之间没有一致性。
senses.why: Consistency is consist + -ency. Latin consistere meant 'to stand together, stand firm'; parts that stand together hold one shape. The -ency suffix names that state, so consistency is the quality of standing together without breaking apart.
senses.whyCN: consistency 是 consist + -ency。拉丁语 consistere 意为“站在一起、站稳”；能站在一起的各部分保持着同一形态。-ency 命名这种状态，所以 consistency 就是“站在一起而不散开”的性质。

senses.title: Consistency of results: repeated trials agree
senses.titleCN: 结果一致性：多次试验相互吻合
senses.definition: the degree to which repeated measurements or experiments give the same result
senses.definitionCN: 重复测量或实验给出相同结果的程度
senses.example: The team ran the test five times to check the consistency of the results.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把测试跑了五遍，以检查结果是否一致。
senses.why: Each new result is a thing that must 'stand together' with the previous ones. When they all line up, the run has consistency; a result that falls out of line breaks the standing-together relation.
senses.whyCN: 每一个新结果都是必须与前几次“站在一起”的东西。当它们排成同一条线时，这一轮试验就有一致性；偏离的结果则破坏了这种并立关系。

senses.title: Consistency of behaviour: acting the same way
senses.titleCN: 行为一贯性：以同样的方式行事
senses.definition: the quality of behaving in the same way on different occasions
senses.definitionCN: 在不同场合以相同方式行事的品质
senses.example: Her consistency in arriving early earned her a promotion.
senses.exampleCN: 她一贯早到，这为她赢得了晋升。
senses.why: A person's actions over time are the parts that must stand together. The same person repeating the same conduct makes those actions cohere, so the moral and practical sense grows directly from consistere 'stand firm'.
senses.whyCN: 一个人历时的行为就是必须彼此并立的“各部分”。同一个人重复同样的举动，使这些行为连贯起来，因此这一行为义直接从 consistere“站稳”生长出来。

senses.title: Logical consistency: no contradiction
senses.titleCN: 逻辑一致性：没有自相矛盾
senses.definition: the state in which statements or reasons do not contradict one another
senses.definitionCN: 陈述或理由之间互不矛盾的状态
senses.example: A good argument needs logical consistency from premise to conclusion.
senses.exampleCN: 一个好的论证从前提 到结论都需要逻辑一致性。
senses.why: Propositions stand together when none knocks another down. The Latin image of parts standing firm becomes, in reasoning, the requirement that every claim supports rather than contradicts the rest.
senses.whyCN: 命题彼此并立，就是没有一个把另一个推翻。拉丁语“各部分站稳”的形象，在推理中就变成“每个主张支持而非反驳其余主张”的要求。

senses.title: Texture: the evenness of a mixture
senses.titleCN: 质地均匀度：混合物的稠稀与均匀
senses.definition: the thickness, smoothness, or evenness of a liquid or soft mixture
senses.definitionCN: 液体或软质混合物的浓稠度、细腻度或均匀程度
senses.example: Add water until the batter reaches the consistency of thick cream.
senses.exampleCN: 加水直到面糊达到浓奶油的稠度。
senses.why: Latin consistere also meant 'to be composed of, to have firmness'. A sauce that 'stands together' has the same texture throughout. The physical branch keeps the oldest literal sense of standing firm.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 consistere 也有“由……构成、具有硬度”的意思。能“站在一起”的酱料，整体质地相同。这一物质分支保留了“站稳”最古老的字面义。

senses.title: Consistency check: testing that parts still agree
senses.titleCN: 一致性检查：检验各部分是否仍然吻合
senses.definition: a test that verifies whether stored data or system parts still match one another
senses.definitionCN: 检验存储数据或系统各部分是否仍相互吻合的检查
senses.example: The software runs a consistency check before it saves the database.
senses.exampleCN: 软件在保存数据库之前会运行一致性检查。
senses.why: A check asks whether the parts can still stand together. The noun is used attributively, like a label on the procedure, but the underlying idea is still the -ency state of coherent parts.
senses.whyCN: 检查要问的是各部分是否仍能站在一起。这里名词作定语，像程序上的标签，但底层仍是 -ency 所表示的“部分彼此连贯”的状态。

senses.title: Long-term stability: sameness across time
senses.titleCN: 长期稳定性：长时间保持不变
senses.definition: the quality of remaining reliable and unchanged over a long period
senses.definitionCN: 在长时间内保持可靠、不发生变化的品质
senses.example: The drug's long-term consistency makes it reliable for daily use.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药物的长期稳定性使其适合每日使用。
senses.why: Standing firm is a matter of time as much as of shape. When the same effect holds across years, the parts keep standing together; the temporal reading is an extension of the base verb's 'stand firm'.
senses.whyCN: “站稳”既是形态问题，也是时间问题。当同一效果多年保持，各部分就一直并立；这一时间义是基础动词“站稳”的延伸。

senses.title: Internal consistency: the parts measure one thing
senses.titleCN: 内部一致性：各部分指向同一对象
senses.definition: the degree to which the items within a test or document agree with one another
senses.definitionCN: 测试或文件内部各项目彼此吻合的程度
senses.example: The survey showed high internal consistency across its twenty questions.
senses.exampleCN: 这份调查的二十个问题表现出很高的内部一致性。
senses.why: Internal shifts the focus inside one instrument: its items are the parts that must stand together. High internal consistency means the questions are all pulling in the same direction, like poles standing in one line.
senses.whyCN: internal 把焦点移到同一工具内部：它的各个项目就是必须并立的“部分”。内部一致性高，意味着所有问题都朝同一方向用力，像一根根立在同一线上的杆子。

senses.title: Consistency standard: a rule requiring sameness
senses.titleCN: 一致性标准：要求保持相同的准则
senses.definition: an agreed rule or benchmark that requires decisions or outputs to remain the same
senses.definitionCN: 要求决定或产出保持相同的一致规则或基准
senses.example: The league introduced a consistency standard for referees' decisions.
senses.exampleCN: 联赛为裁判判罚引入了一致性标准。
senses.why: Here the noun modifies 'standard': it names the property the rule demands. The -ency noun of state is turned into a measurable requirement, but the content is still 'things must stand together'.
senses.whyCN: 这里名词修饰 standard：它命名规则所要求的性质。-ency 的状态名词被转成可衡量的要求，但内容仍是“事物必须站在一起”。

intro.en: Consistency is consist + -ency. The base is Latin consistere 'to stand firm, be composed of'. Dates are approximate; the physical and abstract senses developed side by side.
intro.cn: consistency 是 consist + -ency。基础词是拉丁语 consistere“站稳、由……构成”。年代为大致估计；物质义与抽象义是并行发展出来的。

items.en: The base verb is consistere, 'to take one's stand, stand firm; to be composed of'. English consist is borrowed from it and first means 'to have a settled position' before 'to be made up of'.
items.cn: 基础动词是 consistere“站定、站稳；由……构成”。英语 consist 借自它，先有“占据稳定位置”之义，后发展出“由……组成”。

items.en: Consistere is con- 'together' + sistere 'to stand, stand still'. Sistere is related to stare 'to stand', so the picture is several things taking a position together and holding it.
items.cn: consistere 是 con-“一起” + sistere“站立、站住”。sistere 与 stare“站立”同源，因此画面是若干事物一起就位并保持住。

items.en: Consist + -ency (from Latin -entia through French -ence) formed consistency, a noun of state: 'the condition of standing together'. The suffix adds no new meaning; it turns the verb's state into an abstract quality.
items.cn: consist + -ency（经法语 -ence 来自拉丁语 -entia）构成 consistency，这是状态名词：“站在一起的状态”。后缀不增添新义，只把动词的状态转成抽象性质。

items.en: Early English uses cover both 'firmness, density' of a substance and 'agreement, harmony' of parts. The physical sense is not a later metaphor; it preserves the literal 'stand firm / be composed of'.
items.cn: 早期英语用法同时包括物质的“硬度、密度”和部分的“一致、和谐”。物质义不是后来的比喻，而是保留了“站稳／由……构成”的字面义。

items.en: As the word moved into argument, conduct and data, the concrete image faded: what stands together became what agrees. The texture sense stayed in cooking and chemistry, while the abstract sense generalized to logic and behaviour.
items.cn: 当这个词进入论证、行为和数据领域，具体形象淡化了：站在一起的东西变成了相互吻合的东西。质地义留在烹饪与化学中，抽象义则扩展到逻辑与行为。

items.en: Modern usage measures consistency: high or low internal consistency, consistency of results, consistency checks. The -ency noun now functions as a countable and uncountable quality noun with a technical edge.
items.cn: 现代用法对 consistency 进行度量：内部一致性高低、结果一致性、一致性检查。-ency 名词现在既是可数又可不可数的性质名词，并带技术色彩。

note.en: The first group contains words that look or sound close to consistency; the second contains nouns with a nearby meaning.
note.cn: 第一组是拼写或读音接近 consistency 的词；第二组是意思相近的名词。

entries.definition: an older variant of consistency, now rare and mostly limited to the physical sense.
entries.definitionCN: consistency 的旧变体，现已罕用，多限于物质义。

entries.definition: a voting district or the voters in it. It belongs to constituent, not to consist.

entries.definition: the quality of parts fitting together clearly and logically. It stresses intelligible connection, while consistency stresses sameness.
entries.definitionCN: 各部分清晰、合逻辑地结合在一起的品质。它强调可理解的关联，而 consistency 强调相同。

entries.definition: the state of being the same in form or character. It is closer to 'identical' than consistency is.
entries.definitionCN: 在形式或性质上相同的状态。它比 consistency 更接近“完全一样”。

entries.definition: the quality of staying steady and not changing. It emphasizes resistance to disturbance.
entries.definitionCN: 保持平稳、不改变的性质。它强调抵抗干扰的能力。

entries.definition: the quality of remaining the same or loyal over time. It is more literary and personal than consistency.
entries.definitionCN: 随着时间保持相同或忠诚的品质。它比 consistency 更文学化、更偏个人情感。

entries.definition: the state of matching or having the same opinion. It is broader and less technical than consistency.
entries.definitionCN: 相互吻合或意见相同的状态。它比 consistency 更宽泛、更不技术化。

normalIntro.en: These links use the real consist family, the real -ency suffix, and real collocations.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联系使用真实的 consist 词族、真实的 -ency 后缀和真实搭配。

normal.en: consist means 'stand together'. Add -ency and you get the state of standing together: consistency.
normal.cn: consist 意为“站在一起”。加上 -ency，就得到“站在一起的状态”：consistency。

normal.en: The family is easy to hold in one line: consist → consistent → consistently → consistency, with in- negating the last three.
normal.cn: 这个词族可以串成一条线：consist → consistent → consistently → consistency，而 in- 否定后三个。

normal.en: The physical sense survives in the kitchen: whisk the sauce to the right consistency.
normal.cn: 物质义仍活在厨房里：把酱汁搅到合适的浓稠度。

normal.en: Typical frames: maintain consistency, achieve consistency, internal consistency, consistency check, consistency of results.
normal.cn: 典型搭配：maintain consistency、achieve consistency、internal consistency、consistency check、consistency of results。

normal.en: -ency marks a noun of state or quality, as in frequency and agency. Here the state is 'not changing'.
normal.cn: -ency 标记状态或性质名词，如 frequency、agency。这里的状态是“不改变”。

abstract.en: Picture several poles standing in one straight line. As long as none leans, they are consistent; one leaning pole is an inconsistency.
abstract.cn: 想象几根杆子立成一条直线。只要没有一根倾斜，它们就是一致的；一根倾斜的杆子就是一处不一致。

abstract.en: Pour the same mixture twice and compare the texture. The sameness you feel is consistency in its oldest physical sense.
abstract.cn: 把同一混合物倒两次，比较质地。你摸到的那种相同感，就是 consistency 最古老的物质义。

abstract.en: Across all nine senses one test remains: do the parts still stand together, or has something broken the line?
abstract.cn: 九个义项共用同一个检验：各部分是否仍站在一起，还是有东西破坏了这条线？

examples.en: The report found a lack of consistency between the two data sets.
examples.cn: 报告发现两组数据之间缺乏一致性。

examples.en: Whisk the sauce until its consistency is smooth and even.
examples.cn: 把酱汁搅打至质地细腻均匀。

examples.en: Her consistency in training explains her steady improvement.
examples.cn: 她训练的一贯性解释了她为何能稳步进步。

dict_mnemonic.text: “肯细思坦西”——肯细细思量，站得稳、前后不变 → consistency 一致性

root: consist（拉丁 consistere“站在一起、站稳”）+ -ency（名词后缀）：由“站得住”转为“前后一致、质地均匀”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of consistency all test one thing: whether parts stand together. The parts may be statements, results, actions, measurements, or the texture of a mixture.
sensesIntro.cn: consistency 的九个义项都在检验同一件事：各部分是否站在一起。这些部分可以是陈述、结果、行为、测量数据，或混合物的质地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same mixture poured twice, identical in colour and texture.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一桶颜料反复倒出，颜色与质地分毫不差。

branches.en: AGREEMENT AND STANDARD: general sameness, and the rule that demands it.
branches.cn: 一致与标准：总体上的相同，以及要求相同的规则。

branches.en: RESULTS AND CHECKS: repeated outputs agree, and a procedure verifies that they still do.
branches.cn: 结果与检查：重复产出相互吻合，并有程序检验它们仍然吻合。

branches.en: BEHAVIOUR OVER TIME: the same conduct repeated, and reliability across a long period.
branches.cn: 历时的行为：重复同样的举动，以及在长时间内的可靠性。

branches.en: LOGIC AND INTERNAL STRUCTURE: claims do not contradict, and items inside one instrument point the same way.
branches.cn: 逻辑与内部结构：主张互不矛盾，同一工具内部各项目指向同一方向。

branches.en: PHYSICAL TEXTURE: the oldest concrete sense, where a mixture literally stands together.
branches.cn: 物质质地：最古老的具体义，混合物在字面意义上“站在一起”。

intro.en: Consistency is built with -ency, a noun-of-state suffix, on the verb consist. The same base also takes -ent (consistent) and -ence (consistence), so the family shows how one Latin verb branches into several word classes.
intro.cn: consistency 由状态名词后缀 -ency 加在动词 consist 上构成。同一词基还接 -ent（consistent）和 -ence（consistence），因此这个词族展示了一个拉丁动词如何分成多个词类。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is consistere, from con- 'together' + sistere 'to stand'. Latin -entia gave the noun suffix; the English branch also uses -ent and -ence.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁层是 consistere，来自 con-“一起” + sistere“站立”。拉丁语 -entia 提供了名词后缀；英语这一支还使用 -ent 与 -ence。

items.meaning: to be composed of; to stand together
items.meaningCN: 由……组成；站在一起（con- 表示“一起”）
items.example: The team consists of five members.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队由五名成员组成。

items.meaning: always behaving or happening in the same way
items.meaningCN: 一致的；始终如一的（-ent 构成形容词）
items.example: Her story was consistent with the evidence.

items.meaning: in the same way every time
items.meaningCN: 一贯地（形容词 + -ly 构成副词）
items.example: He has consistently supported the plan.

items.meaning: the state of parts standing together
items.meaningCN: 一致性；连贯性（-ency 构成状态名词）
items.example: The consistency of the data surprised the researchers.
items.exampleCN: 数据的一致性让研究人员感到惊讶。

items.meaningCN: 不一致的；矛盾的（in- 否定）
items.example: His accounts of the trip were inconsistent.
items.exampleCN: 他对这次旅行的叙述前后矛盾。

items.meaning: a case or quality of not agreeing
items.meaningCN: 不一致；矛盾之处（in- + -ency 名词）
items.example: The audit found several inconsistencies in the records.
items.exampleCN: 审计发现记录中有几处不一致。

items.meaning: an older form of consistency, especially of texture
items.meaningCN: consistency 的旧形式，尤指质地（-ence 变体）
items.example: The mixture had the consistence of honey.
items.exampleCN: 这混合物具有蜂蜜般的稠度。

items.meaning: the quality of not contradicting oneself
items.meaningCN: 自洽；自身一致（self- 表示“自我”）
items.example: The theory was praised for its self-consistency.
items.exampleCN: 该理论因自洽而受到称赞。

items.meaning: being made up of, used in the phrase 'consisting of'
items.meaningCN: 由……组成的（-ing 分词，用于 consisting of）
items.example: The committee, consisting of seven experts, met on Monday.
items.exampleCN: 由七名专家组成的委员会在周一开会。

latinEntries.meaning: to stand firm, take one's stand; to be composed of
to stand, stand still, set up

latinEntries.meaningCN: 状态或性质（构成抽象名词）

definition_zh: 一贯的；前后一致的；与…相符的
definition_en: always behaving or happening in the same way, or in agreement with something
core_image: 一条笔直的刻度线，从头到尾没有偏移
scene: 教练翻看整季的记录，发现队员的状态几乎没有起伏。Her consistent effort finally paid off.
sceneCN: 这里 consistent 指「一贯的」（第 1 个义项：长期保持同样的标准）；句意是她一贯的努力终于有了回报。

pos.zh: 一贯的；前后一致的；与…相符的

senses.title: Staying the same
senses.definition: keeping the same standard or pattern over time
senses.definitionCN: 在时间里保持同样的标准或做法
senses.example: Her grades were consistent all year.
senses.exampleCN: 她全年的成绩一直很稳定。
senses.why: A pattern only becomes visible when it repeats without breaking.
senses.whyCN: 只有不被打断地重复，一种做法才会显出形状。

senses.title: In agreement
senses.definition: matching another fact, rule or account
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事实、规则或说法相吻合
senses.example: His story is consistent with the evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 他的说法与证据相符。
senses.why: Two pieces of a puzzle are trusted when their edges fit.
senses.whyCN: 拼图的两块只有边对得上，才让人相信。

senses.title: Steady in quality
senses.definition: holding the same quality or texture without sudden change
senses.definitionCN: 质地或品质保持不变，没有突然的波动
senses.example: The sauce has a consistent texture.
senses.exampleCN: 这酱汁的质地很均匀。
senses.why: Hands and tongues notice a single lump at once.
senses.whyCN: 手和舌头一下子就能察觉出那一点疙瘩。

intro.en: Consistent comes from Latin consistens, the present participle of consistere, to stand firm together.
intro.cn: consistent 来自拉丁语 consistens，是 consistere（一起站稳）的现在分词。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and sistere meant to take a stand.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，sistere 意为站定。

items.en: Consistere described things holding their place together.
items.cn: consistere 描述事物一起守住各自的位置。

items.en: Consistens named whatever stood firm without shifting.
items.cn: consistens 指稳稳站住、不肯移动的事物。

items.en: French consistant used the word for firm and solid things.
items.cn: 法语 consistant 用它形容坚实不散的东西。

items.en: English consistent moved from physical firmness to steady behaviour.
items.cn: 英语 consistent 从实体的坚固转向行为的稳定。

items.en: It now chiefly means agreeing with itself or with the facts.
items.cn: 如今它主要指与自身或与事实相符。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin stand base, and the meaning group names other words for a pattern that does not break.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的站立词基，近义组列出其他表示「不中断的做法」的词。

entries.definition: to be made up of particular parts
to demand something firmly
to continue in spite of difficulty
developing or moving at an even rate
happening all the time without a pause
the same in all its parts

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from parts that keep standing in place, then move to two edges that fit and to an even texture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从守在原位的各部分开始，再到对得上的两条边，最后到均匀的质地。

normal.en: Con- is together and sist is stand, so consistent is standing together without slipping.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sist 是站立，consistent 就是一起站住而不滑动。

normal.en: A ruler with no bent mark: that is a consistent record.
normal.cn: 一把没有任何弯折刻度的尺子，就是一贯的记录。

normal.en: Two puzzle edges that fit mean the accounts are consistent.

normal.en: Consistent effort is boring to watch and hard to beat.

normal.en: Say the same true thing on a good day and a bad day.
normal.cn: 在顺境和逆境里说同一句真话。

abstract.en: Picture a compass drawing the same circle twice.
abstract.cn: 想象一把圆规把同一个圆画了两遍。

abstract.en: Picture a row of bricks all set at the same height.
abstract.cn: 想象一排砖都砌在同一高度。

abstract.en: Picture a heartbeat line that keeps an even rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象一条保持均匀节奏的心跳线。

examples.en: The team showed consistent improvement over the season.
examples.cn: 这支队伍在整个赛季里稳步提高。

examples.en: Her answer was consistent with the facts.
examples.cn: 她的回答与事实相符。

examples.en: He is consistent in the way he treats people.
examples.cn: 他待人接物的方式始终如一。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consistent 记成 con（一起）加 sist（站立）加 ent：始终站在同一个位置不动，就是一贯的、前后一致的。

root: 源自拉丁语 consistere（com 一起 + sistere 站立）的现在分词 consistens，本义是稳稳站住，后指一贯不变与前后相符。

sensesIntro.en: From a pattern that never shifts, to two accounts that fit, and finally to an even texture you can feel.
sensesIntro.cn: 从从不改变的做法，到彼此吻合的两种说法，最后到手上能摸出的均匀质地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight line of marks with no gap and no tilt.

branches.en: The first sense is a habit repeated until it looks like a line.

branches.en: The second sense judges whether two accounts share an edge.
branches.cn: 第二个义项判断两种说法是否共享同一条边。

branches.en: The third sense is evenness you can feel with hand or tongue.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是手或舌头能感到的均匀。

branches.en: Both senses ask whether something would look the same on a second look.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在问：再看一遍是否还是这个样子。

branches.en: A steady hand and a steady sauce both refuse sudden change.
branches.cn: 稳定的手与均匀的酱汁都拒绝突然的变化。

definition_zh: 巩固；使坚实；合并；把……合成一个整体
definition_en: to make something firm and solid, or to press separate parts into one body
core_image: 散落的砖块被压进一块整石，缝隙里灌满灰浆，再也掰不开
scene: 两家小厂把账目、仓库与工人名单并到一处，只留一个管理层。The two firms consolidate their warehouses and accounts into one system.
sceneCN: 这里指把分散的部门与账目合成一个整体（第 2 个义项：把多个单位并入一个机构）；句意：这两家公司把仓库与账目合并成一套系统。

senses.title: To make ground or a structure firm
senses.definition: to press loose material or a built structure until it can carry weight without shifting
senses.definitionCN: 把松散的材料或已建的结构压紧，使其承重而不位移
senses.example: Workers consolidate the soil before the foundation is laid.
senses.exampleCN: 工人在打地基之前先把土层压实。
senses.why: The Latin adjective inside the verb means solid, so the first sense is simply to make something solid.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词里的拉丁形容词意为坚实，因此第一个义项就是使某物变坚实。

senses.title: To merge separate units into one
senses.definition: to combine two or more organizations, departments or functions into a single body
senses.definitionCN: 把两个或更多组织、部门或职能合成一个机构
senses.example: The two firms consolidate their warehouses and accounts into one system.
senses.exampleCN: 这两家公司把仓库与账目合并成一套系统。
senses.why: Units made solid by being joined cannot be pulled apart again, so merging is pictured as hardening.
senses.whyCN: 各单位一旦合成一体便再难拆开，因此合并被想象成变硬的过程。

senses.title: To secure power or control
senses.definition: to make a hold on power or authority firmer and less easy to shake
senses.definitionCN: 使对权力或权威的掌握更牢固、更难动摇
senses.example: The new mayor spent the first year consolidating her support.
senses.exampleCN: 新市长用第一年巩固自己的支持基础。
senses.why: Power that is solid cannot be shaken, so securing it is described as making it solid.
senses.whyCN: 权力若坚实便难以撼动，因此稳固权力就被说成使之坚实。

senses.title: To combine debts or financial claims
senses.definition: to roll several loans or claims into one obligation with a single schedule
senses.definitionCN: 把多笔贷款或债权并成一项义务，只用一张还款表
senses.example: The family consolidated three credit cards into one loan.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人把三张信用卡的欠款并成一笔贷款。
senses.why: Several debts are pressed into one solid block, which is easier to carry and to count.
senses.whyCN: 多笔债务被压成一块整块，既好背负，也好计算。

senses.title: To make learning durable
senses.definition: to repeat and reorganize knowledge until it resists forgetting
senses.definitionCN: 反复复习并重新组织知识，使其不易被遗忘
senses.example: Short daily reviews consolidate what the students learned in class.
senses.exampleCN: 每天短时复习能巩固学生在课堂上学到的东西。
senses.why: A memory becomes solid when repeated practice closes the gaps between its pieces.
senses.whyCN: 反复练习填上记忆碎片之间的缝隙，记忆才变得坚实。

senses.title: To merge scattered records
senses.titleCN: 把分散的记录整合起来
senses.definition: to gather records kept in different places into one store that can be searched as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 把存放在不同地点的记录汇入一个可整体检索的库
senses.example: The hospital consolidated patient files from five clinics.
senses.exampleCN: 这家医院把五个诊所的病人档案整合到一起。
senses.why: Scattered records are like loose bricks; putting them in one store is pressing them into a block.
senses.whyCN: 分散的记录如同散砖，汇入一处就是把它们压成一整块。

senses.title: To lock in a gain or result
senses.definition: to protect a success already won so that it cannot be lost by later change
senses.definitionCN: 保护已经取得的成功，使其不因后续变化而丧失
senses.example: The team consolidated its lead with a second goal.
senses.exampleCN: 球队用第二个进球锁定了领先优势。
senses.why: A win is not safe until it is made firm, so securing a result is called consolidating it.
senses.whyCN: 胜利在变牢之前并不安全，因此保住结果被称为巩固它。

senses.title: Of sediment hardening into rock
senses.definition: in geology, of loose sediment, to harden into rock under pressure and mineral cement
senses.definitionCN: 在地质学中，指松散沉积物在压力与矿物胶结作用下硬结成岩
senses.example: Over millions of years the sand consolidated into sandstone.
senses.exampleCN: 历经数百万年，砂粒固结成了砂岩。
senses.why: Geology kept the most literal sense: loose grains really do become one solid mass.

intro.en: Consolidate is a Latin verb of solidity: a prefix meaning together and an adjective meaning solid. English took it in the sixteenth century and later stretched it from ground to companies and to memory.
intro.cn: 本词是一个表示坚实的拉丁动词：前缀意为一起，形容词意为坚实。英语在十六世纪借入，后来从土地扩展到公司，再扩展到记忆。

items.en: Solidus meant solid, whole and undivided; the adjective is the part that matters for this verb.
items.cn: 这个拉丁形容词表示坚实的、完整的、不可分的；对这个动词而言，起作用的是形容词义。

items.en: The prefix com- added togetherness and intensity, so the compound meant to make thoroughly solid.
items.cn: 前缀表示一起并加强语气，因此复合词意为彻底使坚实。

items.en: Latin consolidare meant to make firm, and also to knit broken parts into a whole.
items.cn: 拉丁语动词表示使牢固，也指把破碎的部分接合成整体。

items.en: English borrowed it in the sixteenth century, first for making structures, positions and claims firm.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入，先用于使建筑、阵地与主张牢固。

items.en: Banks and companies later used it for pressing many debts or units into one body.
items.cn: 银行与公司后来用它指把多笔债务或多个单位压成一个整体。

items.en: Modern psychology and computing extended it to knowledge and records that must not fall apart.
items.cn: 现代心理学与计算机把它扩展到不可散失的知识与记录。

note.en: The first group shares the solid root or looks close to it; the second group names nearby acts of joining and strengthening.
note.cn: 第一组共享坚实的词根或字形相近；第二组是相邻的连接与加强行为。

entries.definition: Firm and without gaps; it describes the state the verb produces.

entries.definition: To comfort someone in grief; it comes from a different Latin verb and has nothing to do with solidity.

entries.definition: To join two bodies into one; it names the joining without the idea of hardening.

entries.definition: To make a thing stronger; it may add force without adding solidity.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物更强；可能增添力量而不增添坚实度。

entries.definition: To make parts share one identity; it stresses unity rather than material firmness.
entries.definitionCN: 使各部分共有一个身份；强调统一，而非材质坚实。

entries.definition: To add support to something already there; extra material is brought in.

entries.definition: To make a hold safe from loss; it names protection rather than compression.

intro.cn: consortium 是 consort 背后的拉丁「合伙」。

latinIntro.en: Latin sors is a lot and consortium is a sharing of it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sors 意为签，consortium 意为共享此签。

definition_zh: 不断的；恒定的；忠诚的
definition_en: happening all the time without stopping, or staying the same in value
core_image: 钟摆一刻不停地摆动，幅度始终不变
scene: 夜里水管一直滴水，声音从没停过。The constant dripping kept her awake.
sceneCN: 这里 constant 指「不断的」（第 1 个义项：持续不停发生）；句意是不断的滴水声让她睡不着。

senses.title: Never stopping
senses.definition: happening again and again without a real pause
senses.definitionCN: 反复发生而没有真正的停顿
senses.example: The constant noise made it hard to sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 不断的噪音让人难以入睡。
senses.why: A sound that never stops becomes a presence in the room.
senses.whyCN: 从不停止的声音，会变成房间里的一个存在。

senses.title: Staying the same
senses.definition: remaining at the same level or value
senses.definitionCN: 保持在同一个水平或数值上
senses.example: Keep the oven at a constant heat.
senses.exampleCN: 让烤箱保持恒定的温度。
senses.why: Science needs a number that refuses to move.
senses.whyCN: 科学需要一个不肯移动的数字。

senses.title: Loyal and faithful
senses.definition: remaining loyal to a person over a long time, a literary sense
senses.definitionCN: 长久地忠于某人，是较为书面的义项
senses.example: He remained her constant friend.
senses.exampleCN: 他始终是她忠诚的朋友。
senses.why: A heart that does not shift is also called constant.
senses.whyCN: 一颗不肯改变的心，也被称作忠贞。

intro.en: Constant comes from Latin constans, the present participle of constare, to stand firm, built from com-, together, and stare, to stand.
intro.cn: constant 来自拉丁语 constans，是 constare（站稳）的现在分词，由 com-（一起）与 stare（站立）构成。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and constare meant to stand firm together.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，constare 意为一起站稳。

items.en: Constans described a thing that kept its place and its nature.
items.cn: constans 描述守住位置与本性的事物。

items.en: Writers used it for people steady in loyalty.
items.cn: 作家用它形容忠诚不移的人。

items.en: French constant kept both the steady and the faithful senses.
items.cn: 法语 constant 同时保留稳定与忠贞两层意思。

items.en: English constant first described firm and unchanging things.
items.cn: 英语 constant 最初形容坚实不变的事物。

items.en: It now also names a fixed number in mathematics.
items.cn: 如今它也是数学里的一个固定数值。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin stand base or the same ending, and the meaning group names other words for something that does not stop.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语站立词基或相同词尾，近义组列出其他表示「不停」的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a point that refuses to move, then move to a fixed number and to a heart that stays loyal.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一个不肯移动的点开始，再到一个固定的数值，最后到一颗守着忠诚的心。

normal.en: Con- is together and stant is standing, so constant is standing still and refusing to budge.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，stant 是站立，constant 就是站定不动、不肯让步。

normal.en: A clock that ticks every second is constant, not fast.
normal.cn: 每秒滴答一次的钟是恒常，而不是快。

normal.en: Constant heat keeps a cake rising evenly.
normal.cn: 恒定的温度让蛋糕均匀地涨起来。

normal.en: The same friend in every season is a constant friend.
normal.cn: 每个季节都在的朋友，才是忠诚的朋友。

normal.en: What never pauses becomes part of the background.
normal.cn: 从不停下的东西，会变成背景的一部分。

abstract.en: Picture a pendulum swinging with the same width forever.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟摆永远以同样的幅度摆动。

abstract.en: Picture a straight line across a graph with no slope.
abstract.cn: 想象图上一条毫无倾斜的直线。

abstract.en: Picture one lamp left on in a window all night.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇窗里整夜亮着的一盏灯。

examples.en: The constant rain ruined the whole trip.
examples.cn: 不停的下雨毁了整个行程。

examples.en: Keep the room at a constant temperature.
examples.cn: 让房间保持在恒定的温度。

examples.en: She was a constant source of support.
examples.cn: 她始终是支持的来源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 constant 记成 con（一起）加 stant（站立）：始终站在原地不动，就是恒定的、不间断的。

root: 源自拉丁语 constare（com 一起 + stare 站立），本义是一起站稳，后指持续不断、数值恒定与忠诚不渝。

sensesIntro.en: From a sound with no pause, to a number that will not move, and finally to a heart that stays true.
sensesIntro.cn: 从毫无停顿的声音，到不肯移动的数字，最后到一颗始终如一的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pendulum with the same swing, again and again.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只以同样幅度一遍遍摆动的钟摆。

branches.en: The first sense is repetition so regular that it becomes background.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是规律到成为背景的重复。

branches.en: The second sense is a value that refuses to drift.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是一个拒绝漂移的数值。

branches.en: The third sense moves the same steadiness into loyalty.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把同样的稳定移到忠诚上。

branches.en: Both senses describe something you can measure and predict.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述可以测量和预测的事物。

branches.en: A constant number and a constant friend both keep their word.
branches.cn: 恒定的数值与忠诚的朋友都守着自己的承诺。

intro.en: Constant is built on Latin con-, together, plus stare, to stand, with the adjective ending -ant.
intro.cn: constant 由拉丁语 con-（一起）、stare（站立）与形容词词尾 -ant 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base stat- also appears in statue, stable and station.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基 stat- 也出现在 statue、stable 与 station 中。

items.meaning: the quality of staying the same
items.exampleCN: 她的坚贞让所有人惊讶。

items.meaning: a figure made to stand still
items.example: A bronze statue stood in the square.

definition_zh: 不断地；一再地；始终
definition_en: in a way that keeps happening without a real break
core_image: 秒针一圈圈走过，从不停下
scene: 她一边打电话，一边在门口来回走动。He is constantly checking whether the door is locked.
sceneCN: 这里 constantly 指「不断地」（第 1 个义项：反复而不停歇）；句意是他不停地确认门有没有锁好。

senses.title: Without stopping
senses.definition: continuing without any real break
senses.definitionCN: 持续进行而几乎没有间断
senses.example: The machine runs constantly all night.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器整夜不停地运转。
senses.why: Some processes only stop when the power does.
senses.whyCN: 有些过程只在断电时才停下。

senses.title: Again and again
senses.definition: repeating so often that it starts to annoy
senses.definitionCN: 重复得太多，已经开始惹人烦
senses.example: He constantly interrupts me.
senses.exampleCN: 他一再打断我。
senses.why: A habit repeated too often turns into noise.
senses.whyCN: 重复太多的习惯，会变成噪音。

senses.title: All the while
senses.definition: during the whole of a period, without a gap
senses.definitionCN: 在整个一段时间里，没有间断
senses.example: She was constantly aware of the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 她始终留意着那只钟。
senses.why: A quiet state can last as long as the day does.
senses.whyCN: 一种安静的状态，可以和一天一样长。

intro.en: Constantly is constant plus -ly, from Latin constans, standing firm, which comes from constare, to stand together.
intro.cn: constantly 是 constant 加 -ly，源自拉丁语 constans（稳稳站住），其词根是 constare（一起站立）。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and constare meant to stand firm.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，constare 意为站稳。

items.en: Constans described what kept its place and nature.
items.cn: constans 描述守住位置与本性的事物。

items.en: French constant passed the steady sense into English.
items.cn: 法语 constant 把稳定的含义带进英语。

items.en: The adverb constantli first meant in a steady manner.
items.cn: 副词形式最初指以稳定的方式。

items.en: It widened to mean again and again over time.
items.cn: 它的词义扩大为在时间中反复发生。

items.en: Today it often carries a hint of complaint.
items.cn: 今天它常带一点抱怨的意味。

note.cn: 形近组共享 constant- 词族或 -antly 词尾，近义组列出其他表示反复动作的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a second hand that never rests, then move to an annoying habit and to a state that lasts all day.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从不休息的秒针开始，再到惹人烦的习惯，最后到持续一整天的状态。

normal.en: Constant plus -ly turns a standing thing into an action that never sits down.
normal.cn: constant 加上 -ly，把站住的东西变成一个从不停下的动作。

normal.en: A dripping tap is the sound of constantly.
normal.cn: 滴水的水龙头就是 constantly 的声音。

normal.en: If a friend says it three times before lunch, it is happening constantly.
normal.cn: 若朋友在午饭前说了三遍，那就是一再地发生。

normal.en: Constant is the state, constantly is the motion.
normal.cn: constant 是状态，constantly 是动作。

normal.en: The clock does not decide to be regular; it just is.
normal.cn: 钟并不决定要规律，它本来就这样。

abstract.en: Picture a second hand sweeping the same circle.
abstract.cn: 想象一根秒针扫过同一个圆圈。

abstract.en: Picture small waves hitting the same stone.
abstract.cn: 想象细小的浪一遍遍拍打同一块石头。

abstract.en: Picture a light left on above a shop door.
abstract.cn: 想象一家店门上方一直亮着的灯。

examples.en: She constantly checks her messages during dinner.
examples.cn: 吃饭时她不停地看消息。

examples.en: The two brothers are constantly arguing.
examples.cn: 这两兄弟老是争吵。

examples.en: Prices have been constantly rising this year.
examples.cn: 今年物价一直在上涨。

root: 由 constant 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，constant 源自拉丁语 constare（com 一起 + stare 站立），本义是稳稳站住，故 constantly 指不间断地、一再地。

sensesIntro.en: From a process with no pause, to a habit that repeats too often, and to a state that lasts all day.

core.cn: 核心意象：一根从不停下的钟表指针。

branches.en: The first sense is motion with no gap at all.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是毫无间隙的运动。

branches.en: The second sense is repetition frequent enough to irritate.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是频繁到令人烦躁的重复。

branches.en: The third sense is a state held across a whole period.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是贯穿整段时间的状态。

branches.en: Both senses describe something that fills time without a hole.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述填满时间、没有空洞的事物。

branches.en: What happens all the while is often what we later call a habit.
branches.cn: 始终在发生的事，后来常被我们叫作习惯。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base also appears in constant, constancy and stable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基也出现在 constant、constancy 与 stable 中。
